A review by Stephen et al. assessed 29 studies on ﬁber intake in Europe, the UK, and the US, and found that overall, ﬁber intake in
adult males and females ranged from 15 to 25 g/day and 14–21 g/day respectively (Stephen et al., 2017). The authors noted that
overall intake was higher in Europe as compared to North America. Intakes in children varied more widely and thus were less gener-
alizable. Table 3 outlines the most recent data from NHANES and the NDNS for various age groups (Stephen et al., 2017).
